name: web-frequently-asked-questions-as-staggered-white-cards-on-lilac-haze
title: 'Frequently Asked Questions' as staggered white answer cards in three rows, cropped at the edges over a soft lilac haze
whatItIs: A white page with a bold centred heading and grey paragraph above three rows of small white shadowed cards of bold questions with grey answers, offset from each other and cropped at the sides, over a soft blue-lilac cloud gradient behind.
whatItMeans: Friendly and airy; an offset card wall makes FAQs feel like sticky answers.
techniques: Show questions and answers as small cards.
Keep bold questions and grey answers.

vocabulary.definition: A small card with a question and answer.
A soft blurred colour behind cards.
